ports.notes: AR2200 brochure, order code AR0M0022BA00: '3GE WAN (1GE Combo)' = 2 fixed GE RJ45 + 1 GE RJ45/SFP combo; the combo carries the SFP cage (a 1000BASE-T SFP still gives copper).
Hardware Description '2*GE combo WAN, 8*GE LAN': 8x GE electrical LAN RJ45 + 2x GE combo WAN (RJ45 or LC/PC optical, one forwarding interface) - the 2 combos are the only SFP-capable ports.
Modular chassis: built-in ports come from the installed SRU-400H - 14x 10GE SFP+ (GE-capable) + 10x GE copper RJ45; SIC/WSIC/XSIC cards excluded.
S5735-L series datasheet, L24T4S-A1 row: '24*10/100/1000BASE-T ports, 4*GE SFP ports' - dedicated 1G cages, no combo.
Datasheet row S5735-L48T4X-A1: '48*10/100/1000BASE-T ports, 4*10GE SFP+ ports' - the 'X' suffix is the 4x 10G SFP+ uplink, dedicated.
Hardware Description: '24*10/100/1000BASE-T ports, 4*10GE SFP+ ports' - four separate optical ports auto-sensing 1G/10G, explicitly not combo (the trailing C is not a combo here).
Chassis: only the installed LST7X24BX6E0 line card in slot 1 is modelled - 'twenty-four 10GE optical ports and twenty-four GE optical ports', so all 24 listed ports are SFP+ with zero copper.
Hardware Description for 02352QPP: 24x 10/100/1000BASE-T + four 10GE SFP+ ports (1G/10G auto-sensing); extended-slot cards not counted.
USG6000E Hardware Guide: 'USG6510E AC Host (10*GE RJ45+2*GE SFP)' - GE 0/0/0-7 service + WAN 8-9 are RJ45, GE 0/0/10-11 are dedicated SFP optical.

Hardware Guide '2*GE WAN+8*GE Combo+2*10GE SFP+': the 8 combo ports are optical-capable (SFP or RJ45, one at a time) and counted in sfpCount with the 2 dedicated 10GE SFP+; only the 2 GE WAN ports are copper-only.

XGS-PON SFP ONU stick - the device IS the module and has no copper data port, so 0 RJ45: the XGS-PON SC/APC fibre tail and the SFP+ host edge that plugs into the host's cage are both optical (not receptacle cages).

AP: 10GE RJ45 (PoE in) + GE RJ45 + 10GE SFP+ (the 10GE RJ45 and SFP+ are combo - only one active) + 2 WLAN radios; the 2 antenna-cage radios are included in rj45Count only so the row sums to the stated 5 ports.
